info.name: Depict Lite Ab Test Search (v3) API

items.docs:
Returns suggestions for a given query. Call this while the user is typing to help
the user find what they're looking for. The suggestions are of two types:
- suggestions for search queries that are related to the current query
- suggestions for listings that are related to the current query

Example response:
<pre>
{
  "suggestions_request_id": "c6fa5efd-1bde-43a8-9ac4-434605f53024",
  "suggestions": [
    {
      "type": "query",
      "title": "red hat",
      "suggestions_result_id": "60c5495

Returns recommendations for products related to the search query. Note that this
endpoint takes the same request body as the `/v3/search/results` endpoint, excluding
the pagination parameters. It should be called once the user has exhausted the
search results for their query and the recommended products are typically shown
below the search results.
